findings.problem: No runtime changed, so these remain open: max_elapsed_ms is validated but not enforced as its own ceiling (the effective bounds are the 1000 ms provider timeout and the 5000 ms lease); the UI does not say that a reconciled StartMock never ran, although it fails safe to uncertain with no retry; O03 hides validation details on failed drafts; the client caps characters while the server caps bytes; the journal domain label contains a literal backslash; setup-review history is not git-guarded. REPORT and the slice doc describe these as limitations, not fixes. None of them allows publication, a real call, a retry under a new ID or a cross-household reveal.
findings.fix_check: The merged slice-result and the parent 05-A carried-findings list keep each item as open, and none is described as fixed.

findings.title: New invalid-limit assertions lack an error predicate
findings.problem: The three new constructor cases (changed provider_timeout_ms, an unknown extra key, and a missing lease_ms) use assert.rejects without a code or status matcher. Because validateMockLimits runs immediately after ownData and environmentSnapshot in createSyntheticGenerationService, and the other options come from a valid generationOptions(), the rejection is attributable to the limits, so the criterion is met. A matcher would stop a future unrelated failure from passing these cases vacuously.
findings.fix_check: In a later authorized revision, each case asserts e=>e.code==='validation_failed', and a positive control constructs successfully with exact MOCK_LIMITS.
